studies.label: Field experiment 1: Armor Health healthcare logo contest (main study)

counts_source.locator: PDF p. 20 (printed p. 19), Section 4.1 and Table 1 (Registered designers and Participating designers columns); assignment upon registration: PDF p. 19 (printed p. 18), Figure 4 notes.
counts_source.quote:
A total of 440 designers registered for the experiment, with 292 designers submitting at
least one logo (Table 1).

arms.name: Variation(1)
arms.description: Brief plus one pre-generated AI variation for each of 60 original exemplars, with original-exemplar ratings; focal treatment.

arms.name: Variation(4)
arms.description: Brief plus four pre-generated AI variations for each of 60 original exemplars, with original-exemplar ratings.

arms.name: Open
arms.description: Brief plus 60 original human-designed exemplars and their quality ratings.

arms.name: Blind
arms.description: Brief only, without exemplars or variations.

studies.task: Professional freelance designers created logos for a healthcare brand in a crowdsourcing contest intended to improve click attractiveness in online ads.

ai_tool.name: Authors' pipeline: FLUX.1-dev with Logo LoRA and Optimization LoRA; JoyCaption captions combined with brief-derived prompts

estimates.outcome: Alignment of all submitted logos with leading exemplars (motif, color, composition)
estimates.question: with_ai
estimates.measure_detail: Maximum composite alignment of a submission with the 12 leading original exemplars. Components include motif overlap and text-embedding similarity, color-set overlap, color-moment and atmospheric-style distances, and scene-graph and Hu-moment distances. Standardized component measures are averaged. PDF p. 42 (printed p. 41), Appendix E.2; PDF p. 51 (printed p. WA-7), Web Appendix B.2; PDF p. 53 (printed p. WA-9), Table WA-B.2. automated_score is an approximate label for a computed index, not a model judgment of creativity.
estimates.treatment_arm: Variation (arm composition not stated; possibly Variation(1) and Variation(4) pooled)

stats.difference_is: treatment minus control (Variation minus Blind), as printed

sources.locator: PDF p. 44 (printed p. 43), Table E.3, All Submissions row; Alignment Score and Variation minus Blind columns

estimates.notes: Appendix E does not identify which AI arm or arms its Variation column contains. The label follows the screening form and does not assert pooling or an additional randomized arm. Analytic participant and output counts are not assigned from contest totals because table membership is unconfirmed. Unadjusted all-submission means are retained as construct other. Higher means greater similarity to source exemplars, not between-person similarity. SDs are across outputs; no contrast SE, CI, or test is printed. No participant-level SD is available. The correlation with quality is not a treatment effect. The printed difference is retained without calculation.

open_items: All printed quality and originality treatment regressions control for post-assignment submission date. Full-sample unadjusted or baseline-only-adjusted results are needed under extraction-spec rule 5. This extraction intentionally differs from the screening inventory of adjusted results.
Confirm which AI arm or arms form Variation in Appendix E and provide analytic participant and submission counts for Tables E.2-E.3. No pooled-arm membership or count is inferred.

The alignment SDs are across logos, not designer means. No participant-level SD or contrast SE is printed for unadjusted alignment or feature outcomes; repeated submissions cannot be treated as independent people.
Submission depth lacks arm means, SDs, and numerical tests. The replication does not print a fluency-specific comparison. Output totals have not been divided by participant counts.
Only submitters enter the reported outcome analyses. No intention-to-treat results including registered non-submitters are printed.

Possible designer overlap between the two contests is unstated. The screening sample_overlap identifies no other paper sharing participants, so shared_sample is null; no independent combined sample total is assigned.
The replication states that it follows the main design but does not separately restate assignment timing. Registered-by-condition counts are coded as randomized consistently with that statement.
Distinct participant counts in the high-quality originality subsets and sample membership for perception-based originality are unstated. Submission counts must not be used as people counts.

Study 1 tables print only three condition coefficients while observation totals cover the output volume associated with four arms. Fitted treatment coding and omitted Variation(4) coefficients are unclear; post-treatment adjustment independently excludes these regressions.
Final quality-rater counts and protocol are not explicitly separated from the feedback survey. Designers' countries and disclosure of the AI origin of gallery images are not stated.
notes: Extraction date: 2026-10-10. The whole markdown conversion, including all appendices, was read in order; cited PDF pages were checked with pymupdf. Numbers are transcribed, with printed precision preserved in quotes. No means, totals, differences, standardized effects, SEs, or p-values are derived. Rule 5 is applied literally: equation (1) controls for the date a designer submits work, after assignment, so all quality/originality regressions are in not_extracted. Embedding-originality results additionally select outputs by post-treatment quality. The two studies remain randomized experiments. Retained numerical outcomes are unadjusted all-submission alignment and Table E.2 feature means, coded other. Feature outcomes have null form_outcome_id because the screening form did not enumerate them separately. These descriptive mechanism outcomes are not mediation-adjusted effects and do not provide a pooled creativity estimate. Submission-depth records retain comparisons with missing statistics; S1 includes both AI arms against both controls and each other because Appendix B reports pairwise tests across conditions. No across_people or after_ai outcome is reported for human experimental output. No other file was created or changed.
